editMetrics.name: rmsPositionError
editMetrics.formula: sqrt(mean(||p_ref(t)-p_edit(t)||^2)) over all sampled strand points
editMetrics.interpretation: Lower is better; measures average spatial deviation after editing.

editMetrics.name: silhouetteError
editMetrics.interpretation: Lower is better; approximates screen-space outer contour change using the XZ projection.

editMetrics.name: clumpPreservationScore
editMetrics.interpretation: Higher is better; rewards edits that preserve strand-group length structure.

editMetrics.name: rootLocalityScore
editMetrics.interpretation: Higher is better; indicates how stable root positions stay after editing.

editMetrics.name: editLocalityScore
editMetrics.formula: 1 - editedStrandRatio, where a strand is edited when RMS strand delta > 0.01 * averageReferenceLength
editMetrics.interpretation: Higher is better; estimates how much of the hairstyle remained untouched outside the intended region.

editMetrics.name: boundaryNaturalnessScore
editMetrics.interpretation: Higher is better; compares nearby guide strands across UV-space boundaries to penalize visible discontinuities.

editMetrics.name: editedStrandRatio
editMetrics.interpretation: Lower is better when locality is important; reports the fraction of strands whose sampled deformation exceeds the edit threshold.

editMetrics.name: editToRunLatencyMilliseconds
editMetrics.formula: wall-clock milliseconds spent applying the edit stack and preparing runtime state
editMetrics.interpretation: Lower is better; approximates interactive response time from edit commit to runtime-ready output.

runtimeMetrics.name: selectedClusterCount
runtimeMetrics.formula: number of active-set clusters selected under the current budget
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Higher generally means more corrective work scheduled this frame.

runtimeMetrics.name: selectedGuideCount
runtimeMetrics.formula: total guide strands promoted to full corrective simulation
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Higher means more of the hairstyle receives high-cost correction.

runtimeMetrics.name: estimatedFrameMilliseconds
runtimeMetrics.formula: estimatedFixedCostMilliseconds + selectedClusterCount * estimatedClusterCostMilliseconds
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Predicted frame cost only; it must never be reported as measured FPS evidence.

runtimeMetrics.name: recommendedSolverIterations
runtimeMetrics.formula: budget-adapted iteration recommendation derived from the current budget scale
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Higher means the runtime can afford more local corrective iterations this frame.

runtimeMetrics.name: falseStaticRate
runtimeMetrics.formula: falseStaticCount / max(staticCachedGroupCount + staticTransformedGroupCount, 1)
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Lower is better; measures how often a static classification was contradicted by the full-dynamic reference or repair escalation.

runtimeMetrics.name: groupStaticReuseRate
runtimeMetrics.formula: (staticCachedGroupCount + staticTransformedGroupCount) / max(totalSegmentGroupCount, 1)
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Higher is better only when quality gates remain satisfied.

runtimeMetrics.name: groupDynamicRate
runtimeMetrics.formula: dynamicGroupCount / max(totalSegmentGroupCount, 1)
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Reports how much of the hairstyle required full group-level dynamic solving.

runtimeMetrics.name: deferredCorrectionRate
runtimeMetrics.formula: deferredCorrectionGroupCount / max(totalSegmentGroupCount, 1)
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Reports how often temporary correction was used before full solve or repair.

runtimeMetrics.name: deferredCorrectionSuccessRate
runtimeMetrics.formula: successfulDeferredCorrections / max(deferredCorrectionGroupCount, 1)
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Higher means temporary correction preserved continuity until full work ran.

runtimeMetrics.name: staticDynamicBoundaryErrorMm
runtimeMetrics.formula: mean and maximum shared-point discontinuity at Static/Dynamic boundaries
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Lower is better; verifies that mixed states do not create visible or physical discontinuities.

runtimeMetrics.name: watchdogRepairCount
runtimeMetrics.formula: number of watchdog checks escalating a group to Repair or Dynamic
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Shows whether the safety net detected frozen-cache artifacts.

runtimeMetrics.name: directionCacheMemorySavingRate
runtimeMetrics.formula: 1 - directionCacheMemoryMb / max(fullPositionMemoryMb, eps)
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Higher is better; estimates memory saved by the direction cache.

runtimeMetrics.name: wakeDelayFrames
runtimeMetrics.formula: frame(wake committed) - frame(ground-truth wake became necessary)
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Lower is better; zero or one frame is the normal target.

runtimeMetrics.name: predictiveWakePrecision
runtimeMetrics.formula: truePositive / max(truePositive + falsePositive, 1)
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Higher is better; penalizes unnecessary wake requests.

runtimeMetrics.name: predictiveWakeRecall
runtimeMetrics.formula: truePositive / max(truePositive + falseNegative, 1)
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Higher is better; penalizes missed future motion or contact.

runtimeMetrics.name: wakePositionErrorMm
runtimeMetrics.formula: distance between recovered state and full-dynamic reference at wake
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Lower is better; exposes visible popping after cache reuse.

runtimeMetrics.name: wakeVelocityError
runtimeMetrics.formula: norm(v_recovered - v_reference) at wake
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Lower is better; exposes energy injection or frozen-looking recovery.

runtimeMetrics.name: repairSuccessRate
runtimeMetrics.formula: repairSuccessCount / max(repairAttemptCount, 1)
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Higher is better; a repair counts only after the invariant remains valid for the hold window.

runtimeMetrics.name: repairLatencyFrames
runtimeMetrics.formula: frame(repair accepted) - frame(repair requested)
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Lower is better; measures bounded recovery delay.

runtimeMetrics.name: repairRecurrenceRate
runtimeMetrics.formula: repairRecurrenceCount / max(repairSuccessCount, 1)
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Lower is better; detects repairs that immediately fail again.

runtimeMetrics.name: stateOscillationRate
runtimeMetrics.formula: stateOscillationCount / max(stateTransitionCount, 1)
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Lower is better; detects per-frame Static/Dynamic thrashing.

runtimeMetrics.name: collisionMissRate
runtimeMetrics.formula: collisionMissCount / max(collisionCandidateCount, 1)
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Lower is better; uses the full-dynamic or high-accuracy collision reference.

runtimeMetrics.name: meanPenetrationMm
runtimeMetrics.formula: mean penetration depth over accepted penetration events
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Lower is better; report together with maximum penetration.

runtimeMetrics.name: referenceRmsPositionErrorMm
runtimeMetrics.formula: RMS point-position difference against CPU or full-dynamic reference
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Lower is better; primary physical-correctness comparison.

runtimeMetrics.name: determinismMismatchCount
runtimeMetrics.formula: count of repeated identical-seed runs whose canonical result hash differs
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Must be zero for deterministic benchmark evidence.

runtimeMetrics.name: p99FrameMilliseconds
runtimeMetrics.formula: 99th percentile of measured frameMilliseconds after warm-up
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Lower is better; primary tail-latency metric.

runtimeMetrics.name: p999FrameMilliseconds
runtimeMetrics.formula: 99.9th percentile of measured frameMilliseconds after warm-up
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Lower is better; detects rare but visible stalls.

runtimeMetrics.name: frameBudgetOverrunRate
runtimeMetrics.formula: count(frameMilliseconds > 16.67) / measuredFrameCount
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Lower is better; direct 60 FPS stability measure.

runtimeMetrics.name: realMeasurementAccepted
runtimeMetrics.formula: 1 only when the executable actually ran and telemetry is neither pending nor synthetic
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Must equal one before performance results are publishable.

runtimeMetrics.name: scenarioMethodCoverageRate
runtimeMetrics.formula: present required scenario-method-seed cells / total required cells
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Must equal one for the final comparison table.

runtimeMetrics.name: blockClassificationGpuMilliseconds
runtimeMetrics.formula: GPU timestamp duration of block classification
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Pass-level cost; collect with delayed timestamp readback.

runtimeMetrics.name: groupClassificationGpuMilliseconds
runtimeMetrics.formula: GPU timestamp duration of group certificate and state classification
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Pass-level cost; exposes the mandatory O(N) classification overhead.

runtimeMetrics.name: wakePropagationGpuMilliseconds
runtimeMetrics.formula: GPU timestamp duration of predictive wake propagation
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Pass-level cost of safety-driven wake expansion.

runtimeMetrics.name: compactionGpuMilliseconds
runtimeMetrics.formula: GPU timestamp duration of scan, compaction, and indirect-argument generation
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Pass-level cost required to turn skipped work into real savings.

runtimeMetrics.name: dynamicSolveGpuMilliseconds
runtimeMetrics.formula: GPU timestamp duration of Dynamic group solve
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Primary variable physical-simulation cost.

runtimeMetrics.name: repairSolveGpuMilliseconds
runtimeMetrics.formula: GPU timestamp duration of Repair solve
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Must be bounded during wake storms and collision-heavy scenes.

runtimeMetrics.name: followerReconstructionGpuMilliseconds
runtimeMetrics.formula: GPU timestamp duration of follower reconstruction
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Required to prevent claiming simulation-only savings as whole-hair savings.

runtimeMetrics.name: renderPreparationGpuMilliseconds
runtimeMetrics.formula: GPU timestamp duration of draw-data and render preparation
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Required for end-to-end 60 FPS analysis.

runtimeMetrics.name: hairDrawGpuMilliseconds
runtimeMetrics.formula: GPU timestamp duration of hair drawing
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Separates simulation gains from overdraw and shading cost.

runtimeMetrics.name: totalHairGpuMilliseconds
runtimeMetrics.formula: sum of all hair-specific GPU passes measured by timestamps
runtimeMetrics.interpretation: Use with total frame time; never substitute an estimate.
